master_claims.text: A mirror has a narrow border.
The mirror has straight, slightly angled side edges.
The mirror has a rounded arch across the top.
A separate support extends behind the mirror on the right.
The support holds the mirror upright on the floor.
The mirror has a dark-colored frame.

edit_log: Corrected straight vertical sides to straight, slightly angled side edges (c2)
